fusions.name: Quake Stomp
fusions.desc: Stamps a shockwave through the ground, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning them for 1 second.

fusions.name: Shard off the Toe
fusions.desc: Kicks a jagged shard loose at a target at or below 25% health, dealing 26 damage to the first enemy it meets.

fusions.name: Tremor Hold
fusions.desc: Stamps a tremor through the ground that holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Stone-Shod
fusions.desc: Conjures boots of jagged stone: every hit you take is 1 lower, your armour rises by 8%, you move 4% faster, and 5% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.
